title: Nine Members of Joining
subtitle: 社团与俱乐部 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社团与俱乐部（生活与学习·社团与活动）
meta: 主题语境：社团与俱乐部（生活与学习·社团与活动）　|　核心词汇：club　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 club 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1945 my mother was sent to join ① club she could not afford, and she said the joining was the whole of the lesson. The ② club, meaning the society and not the room, was nine members strong and was joined by whoever came last; club, she said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ club in that town had the same rule, and the ④ club at the end, meaning the one the secretary kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever joined properly. Club, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ club was the whole of the game, meaning the stick it carried and not the society. The ⑥ club, meaning the stick and not any of that, is the only thing in a game that everybody carries and nobody questions; club, he said, is either something you join or the only word that means both a society and a stick. She said the stick is the part they remember.

By 1960 the ⑦ club had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the rule. The ⑧ club of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine members and eleven years of joining; club, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ club I remember is the one at the end, which was joined in 1965 and is still described as the oldest in the county. A ⑩ club, my grandmother said in 1970, is the only thing that improves by being joined; every club, she said, is a stick that has agreed to look like a society. She said the stick was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 社团（指那个团体本身，与那间屋子相对）
C. 固定搭配：join a club 加入一个社团
D. n. 社团（指那个镇上每一个）
E. n. 社团（指末尾那一个）
F. n. 球棒（抽象：它承载的那根棍子）
G. n. 那根棍子（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The club, meaning the society and not the room
club was the whole of the game
the club had become a number in a report
The club of the whole thing
A club, my grandmother said in 1970

answers.why: join a club 意为“加入一个社团”，1945 年母亲被派去加入她交不起会费的那个社团。
club 意为“俱乐部、社团”，指那个团体本身而不是那间屋子，共九名会员，由最后来的人加入。
club 指那个镇上每一个社团，每一个都是同样的规矩。
club 指末尾那一个（干事保留的那一个），是唯一有人认真加入过的。
club 意为“球棒”，抽象指它承载的那根棍子，父亲说 club 就是那场比赛的全部。
club 为抽象用法，指那根棍子本身，是一场比赛里人人都拿、却没人质疑的东西。
club 意为“俱乐部、社团”，到 1960 年这个 club 成了报告里的一个数字。
club 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九名会员和十一年的加入。
club 意为“社团”，我记得的是末尾那一个，1965 年加入，至今仍被说成全县最老的。
club 为抽象总称，祖母说一个社团是唯一会因为被认真加入而变好的东西。
